processBreakdownAtPeak.role: application process tree, role of child processes unknown

limitations: One idle and one playback run are insufficient to define a performance or memory budget or prove a leak.
The sampler records executable names and process relationships, not Chromium --type arguments; renderer/GPU/utility process roles cannot be attributed reliably.
The playback sample includes the Playwright driver and local acceptance fixture; these must not be reported as application-only memory.
Search across a large source catalog, 1080p playback, dense danmaku, and repeated source/window cycles were not measured.
